matching: The GAA MPB inventory is the baseline and retains every classified source line. DIME and PhilGEPS are exact normalized title plus year left joins; missing matches stay as GAA rows with empty source fields. The named-contractor ranking requires a unique DIME candidate with a named contractor.

sourceNotes.DIME: ODV cached DIME project records; contractor and contract amount fields are attributed to the DIME project record.
sourceNotes.PhilGEPS: ODV PhilGEPS award records. MPB keyword results are not assigned to GAA project rows unless the title and year exactly match.
sourceNotes.AMO: ODV PhilGEPS/AMO relationship cache. A name match is a lead for review, not proof of ownership, control, benefit, influence, or wrongdoing.
sourceNotes.PhilGEPS registration: ODV merchant-info cache. Status is Red or Platinum as captured by the source, not a live validity check. The cached merchant records were scraped in November 2025.
sourceNotes.PCAB: ODV PCAB regular-license CSV. Category, license number, government-infrastructure registration flag, and valid-through date are retained from the source. Exact normalized company-name match only.
